column2: Make me an interactive explainer of gradient descent for my ML course notes, as a single HTML page. Use a simple 1-D loss so students can follow every number, and show what happens when the learning rate is too small, about right and too big.
Build an interactive diagram of the TCP three-way handshake and connection teardown, with sequence and ack numbers, for a networking class.
Explain how a regex like a(b|c)*d is matched by an NFA, stepping through the input "abcbd". Figure for docs.
